messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — I saw a perf regression in overnight e2e where long-seq requests (>=1k tokens) suddenly picked the slower attention kernel on Ampere nodes. Can someone confirm telemetry shows a switch?

kai: noted. do we have kpick trace enabled on that run? the autotuner can flip picks based on seqlen buckets, but we need the reasons field to be on.

maria: I replayed the trace. perfbot reported a kernel_change at step 42 with reasons list, but the entries are terse. need more context (batching, kv cache hit, estimated mem).

perfbot: probe: run_id=run-2026-03-15-ampere1, pick_event={pick_id: "p-8f3", model: "gptx-13b", seqlen: 1024, arch: "ampere", batch_size: 2, kv_cache_hit: false, chosen_kernel: "atten_v2_tiled", candidate_scores: {atten_v2_tiled: 0.72, atten_v1_fused: 0.68}, reason_tags: ["seqlen_bucket:>=1024","latency_est:+10ms"], flags: ["RUNTIME_KPICK_TRACE=1","KERNEL_AUTOTUNE=enabled"]}\n
oliver: that perfbot dump is helpful but we need two things: 1) an explicit 'trigger' field (what metric crossed threshold) and 2) the pre/post estimated latency/cost numbers for both chosen and fallback kernels.

sasha: agree. propose adding fields: trigger_metric, est_latency_ms, est_p99_ms, est_cost_token. Also include batching_window_ms and kv_cache_effect (e.g., 'prefix_cached' or 'cold_kv').

jason: implemented a quick patch yesterday: KPICK_VERBOSE=1 emits a CSV line per pick. sample:
```
pick_id,seqlen,arch,batch,kv,chosen,score,trigger,est_latency,est_cost
p-8f3,1024,ampere,2,false,atten_v2_tiled,0.72,seqlen_bucket>=1024,45.2,0.0031
```
we can wire that to traces and correlate with perf samples.

maria: nice. can we also sample only 1% of requests in prod and 100% in canary? we must avoid perf overhead.

kai: yes add KPICK_SAMPLE_RATE=0.01 and KPICK_CANARY_RATE=1. Also added KPICK_CORRELATE_TRACE=1 to attach pick_id to topdown profiles.

oliver: another root cause candidate: batching heuristic uses average seq length per worker — that can misclassify when large variance. Suggest emitting seq_len_distribution per batch in the pick reason.

sasha: will add 'batch_seq_stats' = {min,median,mean,max,p90}. small change to telemetry structs.

maria: thanks. action items: (1) kai/sasha add verbose fields and sampling flags, (2) jason hook CSV lines into tracing pipeline, (3) oliver run a canary with ampere nodes and compare chosen vs fallback latency. I'll follow up tomorrow with diff of canary vs baseline.

perfbot: canary run scheduled: run-2026-03-16-ampere-canary, sample_rate=1.0

maria: :thumbsup:
